config.description: NASA li-ion remaining-useful-life baseline. Battery-holdout split, causal feature engineering, nine models compared, champion selected on validation.

recommendations.disclaimer: Engineering decision support from a research prototype. Not a substitute for battery-management-system protection and not validated for safety-critical or autonomous use. Review by a qualified engineer is required.
